scenes.text: Watch and read: Ama asks: Copy this sentence neatly: “Ama reads at school.” Which copy keeps every word?
The answer is: Ama reads at school.. Copy complete sentences legibly with correct spelling and punctuation.
Watch and read: For your case practice, which spelling correctly writes the name of a person: ama?
The answer is: Ama. Names of people begin with capital letters.
